title: 线性代数 · 使用说明
subtitle: Week 1 · Group 07 · Friday 25 September 2026

blocks.text: 教师自用：计划 09:00–09:50。英文可直接说；中文是备课解释和动作提示，不需读出。A1–A6 是本站给教师活动编的导航编号，不是原 Problem Sheet 的题号。
来源分三层：A1–A6 来自导师《Linear Algebra tutorial ideas 2026》第 2–3 页，不是从正式 13 题直接摘取；B2–B13 才对应 Q1.2–Q1.13，C1 对应 Q1.1。前提概念、详细推导、板书图与 exit check 是本网站的备课补充。页面上方“题目从哪里来”可逐项核对。
课前在黑板留一句：How many different ways can we represent 2 − i? 学生进教室时可先想。开场用两分钟说明方式，随后先让学生画图，再按卡点回顾概念。
主线：先尝试、按需补概念 → A1 同一复数的表示 → A2 向量计算 → A3/A4 两种坐标互换 → A5 复数除法。A6 点积夹角只在学生已学且有时间时做。资料完整不代表本节要全讲完。
原教师指导建议学生成对或三人计算并解释，不建议教师把答案逐题念完。课后作业允许不完美，鼓励把卡住的位置和问题写在提交中。未核实的反馈日期、联系渠道不要临场承诺。
本周 hand-in 的完整解答只供教师备课，本节不要逐步讲完；可给入手提示。已核对本周 Blackboard：Numbas Quiz 1 与 hand-in Q1.1 均于 2026 年 9 月 30 日星期三中午 12 点截止。Quiz 计分、可多次尝试且取最高分；hand-in 不计入总评，用于反馈。
导师要求第一节说明参与方式、联系渠道和反馈安排。可按学校邮件中的真实地址告诉学生如何联系你；反馈目标是提交后一周内，不编造 office hour。导师建议允许学生选正式题或讨论 Q1.13；这不是额外必讲内容。

say.en: This is a working session, not a race through a list. We will use sketches, calculate in pairs, and explain our checks. Please tell me where you get stuck; that is useful information, not a problem.
say.cn: 这是练习课，不是赶题单。通过画图、结对计算和解释检查方法学习；卡住的位置正是值得讨论的信息。

quick.action: 开计时器前先看主线；课上学生动笔时停止读稿。完整解答可按 topic 链接查阅，不按资料库目录一路讲。

check.en: Can I name the one idea I want students to take away from each activity?
check.cn: A1 同对象多表示；A2 分量与方程；A3/A4 长度和方向；A5 共轭消去分母虚部；A6 归一化点积。

title: 开场：发题、先尝试，再补概念
subtitle: 09:00–09:02 · 简短说明，不先讲完整答案

blocks.en: Today we’ll work on a few problems, compare approaches, and discuss the steps that need care. This is practice, not a test.
blocks.cn: 今天先解几道题、比较方法，再讨论需要注意的步骤。这是练习，不是测验。

blocks.en: Have you met polar coordinates and the dot product in lectures yet?
blocks.cn: 讲座已经讲过极坐标和点积了吗？

blocks.en: Please ask questions and explain your thinking, even if you are unsure. Your homework does not have to be perfect: write down where you get stuck so that the feedback can help you.
blocks.cn: 请提问、解释思路，不确定也可以说。作业不必完美：写下卡住的位置，反馈才更有帮助。

blocks.en: The feedback target for submitted homework is within a week. Please write down any specific question you would like the feedback to address.
blocks.cn: 提交作业的反馈目标是在一周内。希望反馈特别回应的问题，可以写在作业上。

blocks.text: 听一两组回答。先进入 A1 的画图小任务；若多数人连第一步都不会，再用 60–90 秒补定义或示范起步。不要要求完全没学过的学生凭空发现新方法。
全课采用短循环：独立尝试 → 两人比较 → tutor 追问/短讲解 → 独立小检查。网页中的板书图是教师参考，等学生尝试后再展开或照画。

say.en: We’ll start with a short attempt, then compare ideas. Please show your working, even if you do not finish.
say.cn: 先尝试，再比较思路。没做完也留下过程。

quick.action: 发学生英文题纸；确认已学内容。两分钟内进入 A1。概念按学生实际卡点补。

check.en: Have you met polar coordinates and the dot product in lectures yet?
check.cn: 讲座是否已经涉及极坐标和点积？

title: A1 热身：同一个数的不同表示
subtitle: 09:02–09:08 · 独立画图 → 两人比较 → 按卡点补概念

blocks.en: How many different ways can we represent the complex number two minus i? First sketch it on an Argand diagram. Then compare with the person next to you. Can you give a vector representation, and perhaps a polar representation?
blocks.cn: 复数 2−i 能用多少种方式表示？先画在 Argand 图上，再与旁边同学比较。能写成向量吗？还可以给出极形式吗？

blocks.text: z=2-i
给 45–60 秒动笔。先请一组给图和坐标，再请另一组给长度；角度尚未学过则接受图示，解释后续会练，不要一开始就展开反三角计算。

blocks.en: Which quadrant must the point be in? What does Pythagoras tell us about its distance from the origin?
blocks.cn: 点一定在哪个象限？用勾股定理可得到离原点多远？

blocks.en: It is in the fourth quadrant, at two, minus one. Its distance from the origin is the square root of five. The picture tells us the angle is below the positive real axis.
blocks.cn: 位于第四象限 (2,−1)，模为 √5。图说明方向在正实轴下方。

blocks.text: 2-i\ \longleftrightarrow\ \begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\end{pmatrix},\quad r=\sqrt5,\quad \theta=-\arctan(1/2)\pmod{2\pi}
2-i=\sqrt5(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta),\quad \theta=2\pi-\arctan(1/2)\ \text{if }0\leq\theta<2\pi

blocks.en: These are different descriptions of the same point. An angle can have more than one numerical representative, so always check the requested interval.
blocks.cn: 这些是同一点的不同描述。角度可有多个数值代表，因此要检查题目要求的范围。

blocks.en: If you already know the polar answer, explain how your sketch rules out an angle in the first quadrant.
blocks.cn: 已经知道极形式的同学，请解释图为什么排除第一象限的角。

say.en: Sketch two minus i. Compare with your partner: what are its coordinates, its length, and its direction? We are not finding different complex numbers. We are describing the same number in different ways. Use the picture before choosing an angle.
say.cn: 先画 2−i，再同桌讨论坐标、长度和方向；强调同一对象的不同表示。

quick.action: 学生写 45–60 秒；先听图和坐标，再核对模。若极坐标没学，暂留方向图示。

check.en: Why is a positive acute angle wrong for this point?
check.cn: 正锐角给正虚部，但原数虚部为负；点必须在第四象限。

steps.en: Draw horizontal Re and vertical Im axes. Mark 2 on Re and −1 on Im; plot their intersection.
steps.zh: 先画 Re 横轴、Im 纵轴；标出 2 和 −1，再画交点。

steps.en: Join the origin to the point. Add dashed projections and label the length √5 only after students calculate it.
steps.zh: 连原点到该点；画虚线投影。学生算完后才标长度 √5。

steps.en: Mark the short clockwise angle −arctan(1/2). If an angle in [0,2π) is required, write 2π−arctan(1/2).
steps.zh: 先标顺时针负角；若要求 [0,2π)，再写等价正角。不要一开始抄满答案。

title: A2 向量计算：先算分量，再解方程
subtitle: 09:08–09:18 · 独立起步，再两人或三人讨论

blocks.en: Work in pairs or threes. Find x and y from these two statements. You have about three minutes to start. One person can calculate, and another can check the steps; then swap roles.
blocks.cn: 两人或三人一组，根据下列两条式子求 x、y。先给三分钟开始；一人计算、一人检查，然后换角色。

blocks.text: u=\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix},\quad v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix},\quad w=\begin{pmatrix}1\\-2\end{pmatrix},\quad x,y\in\mathbb R^2
x=3u-2(v+w),\qquad w-y=y-u
巡视看两点：−2 是否分配到整个 v+w；第二式是否真的把两份 y 合并。先问卡在哪一步，不立刻把答案写出。三分钟后请两组各解释一个式子。

blocks.en: For x, which bracket can you simplify first? For y, can you collect both copies of y on the same side?
blocks.cn: 求 x 时可以先简化哪一个括号？求 y 时怎样把两份 y 移到同一边？

blocks.text: v+w=\begin{pmatrix}2\\0\end{pmatrix},\qquad x=\begin{pmatrix}12\\0\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}4\\0\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}8\\0\end{pmatrix}

blocks.en: The vertical components of v and w cancel. That gives x equal to eight, zero. From w minus y equals y minus u, adding y and u gives u plus w equals two y.
blocks.cn: v 和 w 的竖直分量抵消，所以 x=(8,0)。第二式两边加 y 和 u，得到 u+w=2y。

blocks.text: 2y=u+w=\begin{pmatrix}5\\-2\end{pmatrix},\qquad y=\begin{pmatrix}5/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}

blocks.en: How can we check y without repeating exactly the same rearrangement? Substitute it into both sides of the original equation.
blocks.cn: 不用重复同一套移项，怎样检查 y？把它代回原方程左右两边。

blocks.text: w-y=\begin{pmatrix}-3/2\\-1\end{pmatrix}=y-u

blocks.en: Geometrically, y is the midpoint of the position vectors u and w. Both sides describe the same displacement from u to y and from y to w.
blocks.cn: 从图看，y 是 u、w 对应点的中点；从 u 到 y 与从 y 到 w 的位移相同。

blocks.en: If you finish early, explain why y is a midpoint, or sketch u, w and y. A checked explanation is more useful than a second unexamined answer.
blocks.cn: 提前完成就解释为什么是中点，或画 u、w、y。比再报一个未经检查的答案更重要的是解释。

say.en: Find x and y in pairs. Start with the bracket for x. For y, collect the two copies of y before dividing by two. Be ready to explain one step. When you finish, check y in the original equation, not just in your rearranged version.
say.cn: 结对求 x、y；x 先算括号，y 收集两份 y 再除以 2；代回原式检查。

quick.action: 先给 3 分钟独立合作；巡视后请两组分别解释。答案不要先写满；学生说完再揭示下方板书。

check.en: What are w minus y and y minus u when y is five halves, minus one?
check.cn: 两边均为 (−3/2,−1)，验证成立；若不相等，先查负号。

steps.en: For the first calculation, write v+w=(2,0), then x=(12,0)−(4,0)=(8,0). Keep this separate from the midpoint sketch.
steps.zh: 先在左边算第一问；不要把 x 的计算混进右侧中点图。

steps.en: For the second equation, plot U=(4,0) and W=(1,−2). Ask where Y must lie so that U→Y and Y→W are equal.
steps.zh: 第二问先画 U 和 W，问哪一点 Y 会使 U→Y 与 Y→W 相等。

steps.en: Add Y at the midpoint. Label U→Y as y−u and Y→W as w−y, then write 2y=u+w.
steps.zh: 再标中点 Y；两段箭头方向一致，分别标 y−u 与 w−y，最后写 2y=u+w。

title: A3 极坐标到直角坐标
subtitle: 09:18–09:23 · 先画方向与长度，再算分量

blocks.en: Find x when x equals lambda times u theta, with lambda equal to five and theta equal to pi over four. Use the definition shown here. First predict the signs of the two components.
blocks.cn: 已知 x=λu(θ)，λ=5，θ=π/4，求 x。使用下方定义，先预测两个分量的正负。

blocks.text: u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix},\qquad x=5u(\pi/4)
此处 u(θ) 是单位方向向量，与 A2 中固定的 u=(4,0) 不是同一个定义；提醒学生每道题重新读定义。
给 45–60 秒算；请学生说明为什么两个分量相同。先画第一象限 45° 的方向，再展开公式。

blocks.en: At pi over four, sine and cosine are both one over the square root of two. Multiply both components by five.
blocks.cn: π/4 时正弦余弦都等于 1/√2；两个分量都乘以 5。

blocks.text: x=\begin{pmatrix}5/\sqrt2\\5/\sqrt2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}5\sqrt2/2\\5\sqrt2/2\end{pmatrix}

blocks.en: Should each component be five? No: five is the total length. Check the sum of the squared components.
blocks.cn: 每个分量都应该是 5 吗？不是，5 是整体长度。检查两个分量的平方和。

blocks.en: Both components are positive and equal, so the result also matches our sketch.
blocks.cn: 两个分量同为正且相等，也与图一致。

say.en: Use the unit direction vector at pi over four, then multiply both components by five. Before calculating, predict the signs. After calculating, check the length. Five is the length of the vector, not the value of each component.
say.cn: 先预测符号，用 π/4 的单位方向向量乘 5；算完检查长度，而非让每个分量等于 5。

quick.action: 学生算 45–60 秒；提醒这里的 u(θ) 是新定义，不沿用 A2 的 u。

check.en: How do the components show both a length of five and an angle of pi over four?
check.cn: 平方和 25，所以长度 5；两分量正且相等，对应第一象限 45°。

steps.en: Draw axes and a ray at π/4 in the first quadrant. Mark a length of 5 along the ray.
steps.zh: 先画第一象限 π/4 的射线，再标长度 5。

steps.en: Drop perpendicular dashed lines to the axes; ask which component uses cosine and which uses sine.
steps.zh: 向两轴画垂直虚线，问横、纵分量分别用什么。

steps.en: Write x=5 cos(π/4), y=5 sin(π/4), then label both 5/√2. Check the length is 5.
steps.zh: 先写投影公式，学生算后再标两分量 5/√2；核对长度 5。

title: A4 直角坐标到极坐标
subtitle: 09:23–09:28 · 画两幅图，比较角度约定

blocks.en: Now reverse the process. Write each of these vectors as lambda times u theta, with lambda positive and theta in the interval from zero inclusive to two pi exclusive. Work with your partner.
blocks.cn: 现在反过来。把下面两个向量写成 λu(θ)，其中 λ>0、0≤θ<2π。与同伴一起做。

blocks.text: \begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix},\qquad\begin{pmatrix}0\\-3\end{pmatrix},\qquad u(\theta)=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}
先给 60–90 秒分别画两箭头；问角度从哪里量起、往哪边量。不要把 arctan(y/x) 当万能公式；第二个向量 x=0，直接看轴最清楚。

blocks.en: What is the length of each vector? Which axis does each one point along? Choose the angle only after that.
blocks.cn: 两个向量长度各是多少？各沿哪条轴指向哪边？确认这些之后再选角度。

blocks.text: \begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix}=3u(0),\qquad\begin{pmatrix}0\\-3\end{pmatrix}=3u(3\pi/2)

blocks.en: Both lengths are three. The first angle is zero. The second is three pi over two in the required interval. Minus pi over two points in the same direction, but it is outside this interval.
blocks.cn: 长度都是 3。第一个角是 0；第二个按指定范围取 3π/2。−π/2 方向正确，但不在要求的区间内。

blocks.en: Could we use lambda equal to minus three and angle pi over two for the second vector? It gives the same coordinates, but does it meet this question’s conditions?
blocks.cn: 第二个能否写成 λ=−3、θ=π/2？坐标确实一样，但符合本题条件吗？

blocks.en: No. The question requires lambda to be positive. We keep the length positive and put the direction into theta.
blocks.cn: 不符合，本题明确 λ>0。把长度保持为正，用 θ 表示方向。

blocks.text: 09:28 检查：若有人把方向和负长度混在一起，再用第二幅图巩固，取消 A6。09:28 转 A5；如不得不晚一点，缩短讨论而不是取消最后总结。

blocks.en: If this is straightforward, choose another nonzero vector on an axis and ask your partner for its allowed angle. Do not change the interval.
blocks.cn: 已经熟练就另选一个坐标轴上的非零向量，问同伴规定区间里的角；不要改变题目范围。

say.en: For each vector, sketch first, find the positive length, and then choose an angle in the required interval. The interval matters. Minus pi over two has the right direction for the second vector, but this question asks for three pi over two.
say.cn: 先图、后正长度、再指定区间里的角。第二个方向可说 −π/2，但本题要 3π/2。

quick.action: 学生画图 60–90 秒。09:28 若仍混淆正长度/方向，取消 A6；保留一题复数除法和收尾。

check.en: Why is lambda equal to minus three not an allowed answer here?
check.cn: 虽可配合另一角得到同一向量，但违反题目 λ>0；长度必须为正。

steps.en: Use two sketches. Draw (3,0) to the right and (0,−3) downwards, both from the origin.
steps.zh: 左右两幅图，均从原点画箭头：向右与向下。

steps.en: Keep the radius positive. Start angles at the positive horizontal axis.
steps.zh: 半径保持正值；角度从正横轴开始量。

steps.en: For the downward vector, trace an anticlockwise three-quarter turn and mark 3π/2. Explain why −π/2 is excluded by this question.
steps.zh: 向下的图画逆时针 3/4 圈，标 3π/2；解释 −π/2 虽同方向却不在本题区间内。

title: A5 复数除法：为什么乘共轭
subtitle: 09:28–09:40 · 先尝试，重点讲共轭与上下同乘

blocks.en: Write this expression in the form a plus b i, where a and b are real. Work together for two minutes. Look for a useful simplification before expanding everything.
blocks.cn: 把下列表达式写成 a+bi，a、b 都是实数。先合作两分钟；展开所有东西之前，找一个能简化的结构。

blocks.text: 提醒整段 (3+2i)(3−2i) 是分子，1+i 是分母。巡视常见错误 i²=1、只给分母乘共轭、把 1/(1+i) 写成 1−i。

blocks.en: What happens to the imaginary terms in the numerator? What happens to i squared?
blocks.cn: 分子里的虚数交叉项会怎样？i 的平方是什么？

blocks.en: The cross terms cancel, and i squared is minus one, so the numerator is thirteen. We still need to rewrite thirteen divided by one plus i.
blocks.cn: 交叉项抵消，i²=−1，所以分子为 13。接下来仍要处理 13/(1+i)。

blocks.en: What can we multiply one plus i by to get a real number? And what must we do to the numerator to keep the same value?
blocks.cn: 1+i 乘什么会变成实数？为了不改变原值，分子必须同时怎样做？

blocks.text: 等 5–8 秒，先听“共轭”和“上下同乘”的理由，再写计算。

blocks.en: We multiply the whole fraction by one, written as one minus i over one minus i. The conjugate makes the denominator real because the imaginary cross terms cancel.
blocks.cn: 我们给整个分式乘以 1，只是把 1 写成 (1−i)/(1−i)。共轭使分母虚部交叉项抵消，得到实数。

blocks.en: How can we check the final answer? Multiply it by the original denominator. What should we get?
blocks.cn: 怎样检查最后答案？乘回原分母，应该得到什么？

blocks.text: \left(\frac{13}2-\frac{13}2i\right)(1+i)=13

blocks.en: We recover thirteen, the simplified numerator. The sign and the factor of two are both checked.
blocks.cn: 得到简化后的分子 13，同时检查负号和除以 2 是否正确。

blocks.text: 09:40：若仍在解释此题，不开 A6。请学生用一句话说“为什么乘共轭”，再用乘回检查收束。09:40 若全部已稳且讲座已学点积，才进入可选 A6；否则让学生再解释这题或提一个问题。

say.en: Simplify the numerator first. Then use the conjugate to make the denominator real. Multiply both numerator and denominator, not just one of them. Finally, multiply your answer by the original denominator: you should recover thirteen. That is a useful independent check.
say.cn: 先化分子，再用共轭把分母化实；上下都乘，最后乘回原分母，应得到 13。

quick.action: 留 2 分钟尝试；听完理由再展示答案。09:40 若仍不稳取消 A6，不赶着讲全部题目。

check.en: Why is thirteen times one minus i not the final answer?

steps.en: Draw 1+i and 1−i reflected in the real axis. This picture explains conjugation, not the full division algorithm.
steps.zh: 画 1+i 与 1−i 关于实轴对称；这幅图解释共轭，不把图当完整除法证明。

steps.en: On a separate line simplify the numerator: (3+2i)(3−2i)=13.
steps.zh: 另起一行先把分子化为 13。

steps.en: Write a bracket around BOTH numerator and denominator being multiplied by 1−i. Then show the denominator is 2.
steps.zh: 分子、分母旁同时标乘 (1−i)，强调两者都乘；再写分母为 2。

steps.en: Finish with 13/2−(13/2)i and check by multiplying by 1+i.
steps.zh: 最后整理实部与虚部，再乘回 1+i 检验。

title: A6 可选：点积与夹角
subtitle: 09:40–09:47 · 可选；否则修正前题并做独立检查

blocks.text: 本环节随时可跳过。若学生讲座未覆盖点积/夹角公式，或已经过 09:40 且主线未稳，不临时塞一段新课。

blocks.en: If you have covered the dot product, try this final question. Compute the dot product of these vectors, and hence find the cosine of the angle between them. Predict whether the angle is acute or obtuse.
blocks.cn: 如果已经学过点积，做最后一题：求这两个向量的点积，并求夹角余弦。预测夹角是锐角还是钝角。

blocks.text: a=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\end{pmatrix},\quad b=\begin{pmatrix}6\\-8\end{pmatrix},\qquad a\cdot b=\|a\|\|b\|\cos\phi
给 60–90 秒，问结果是标量还是向量。若有人只报 −10，追问它是不是 cosine；先别替学生算长度。
a\cdot b=1\cdot6+2\cdot(-8)=-10,\quad \|a\|=\sqrt5,\quad\|b\|=10
\cos\phi=\frac{-10}{10\sqrt5}=-\frac1{\sqrt5}

blocks.en: The dot product is minus ten, a scalar. Dividing by the product of the lengths gives minus one over the square root of five. The cosine is negative, so the angle between the nonzero vectors is obtuse.
blocks.cn: 点积是标量 −10；除以两向量长度乘积得到 −1/√5。夹角余弦负，所以夹角为钝角。

blocks.en: We were asked for the cosine, so we can stop here. We do not need an inverse cosine or a decimal angle.
blocks.cn: 题目要的是余弦，到这里可以停，不需要求反余弦或小数角度。

blocks.text: 09:47 直接转总结，不管此题讲到哪一步。若没完成，把未完成的一步留作独立练习，不延长课堂。

say.en: Compute the dot product, then divide by the product of the lengths to find the cosine. These are different numbers. Use the sign as a geometric check: a negative cosine means an obtuse angle. We only need the cosine, not the angle itself.
say.cn: 点积与余弦是两个不同数值；点积还要除以模长乘积。负余弦对应钝角，无需求角度本身。

quick.action: 仅已学且有空才用。学生算 60–90 秒；09:47 无条件收尾。

check.en: Could minus ten be a cosine? What factor are we missing?
check.cn: 不可以，余弦必须在 [−1,1]；缺少除以两模乘积 10√5。

steps.en: Only use this if students have met the dot product. Draw both directions from the same origin.
steps.zh: 仅在已经学过点积时使用；两方向从同一原点画。

steps.en: These arrows are unit directions, not the original vector lengths. Mark the smaller angle between them.
steps.zh: 图中是单位方向，不代表原向量长度。标两方向之间的较小夹角。

steps.en: Calculate with the original vectors: a·b=−10, norms √5 and 10. Hence cos φ=−1/√5.
steps.zh: 计算时仍用原向量：点积 −10，长度 √5 与 10；得 cos φ=−1/√5。

blocks.en: Before we finish, try the exit check on your own. Write the vector (0, minus 2) in polar form, with a positive length and an angle in the interval from zero inclusive to two pi exclusive. Make a quick sketch to check your answer.
blocks.cn: 结束前独立完成题纸最后的小检查：把 (0,−2) 写成极坐标，长度为正，角度在 [0,2π)。画个小图检查。

blocks.text: 给 30–45 秒独立写，不先公布答案。若今天未讲极坐标，改为只画向下长度为 2 的向量；用图与长度检查，跳过角度要求。

blocks.en: The length is two, and the angle is three pi over two. Pi over two points upwards, so it would give the wrong sign. This is why a sketch is useful.
blocks.cn: 长度是 2，角度是 3π/2。π/2 指向上方，符号不对，所以草图能帮助检查。

blocks.en: For polar coordinates, check the length, the direction, and the allowed angle interval. For complex division, the conjugate is useful because it makes the denominator real.
blocks.cn: 极坐标检查长度、方向和允许的角度区间；复数除法中，共轭的作用是把分母化成实数。

blocks.en: Numbas Quiz One and the hand-in question are both due on Wednesday, the thirtieth of September, at twelve noon. The quiz counts towards your grade; you can try it more than once, and your highest score counts. The hand-in is for feedback, not marks towards your final grade. It does not have to be perfect: show your attempt and say where you are unsure.
blocks.cn: Numbas Quiz 1 和 hand-in 均于 9 月 30 日星期三中午 12 点截止。Quiz 计入成绩，可多次尝试，取最高分；hand-in 不计入总评，用于反馈。作业不必完美：展示尝试并说明疑问。

blocks.en: For the hand-in question, start by writing out the vectors and their lengths carefully. For the part with several vectors, think about how to use the two-vector triangle inequality more than once. I will leave the full argument for you to work through.
blocks.cn: hand-in 可从认真写出向量及其长度开始；多个向量那一问，思考如何不止一次使用两个向量的三角不等式。完整论证留给大家自己完成。

blocks.text: 只给上述入手提示，不在本节给出 hand-in 的最终参数值、逐次平方过程、完整不等式链或取等实例。完整教师答案留在单独参考项 C1，不顺着导航朗读。

blocks.en: What is one step you would still like to practise? Make a note of it. Thank you, everyone. We'll finish here.
blocks.cn: 还有哪一步你想继续练？记下来。谢谢大家，我们今天到这里。

blocks.text: 09:50 结束。不承诺未经确认的 office hour、邮件地址或反馈日期。若有人个别提问，先让其他人准时离开，再视后续安排短答。

say.en: On your own, write the vector (0, minus 2) in polar form, using a positive length and an angle from zero inclusive to two pi exclusive. Sketch it and check the signs. Quiz One and the hand-in are due on Wednesday at twelve noon. The quiz counts towards your grade; the hand-in is for feedback. Submit your attempt even if it is incomplete. Thank you; we will finish here.
say.cn: 独立把 (0,−2) 写成极坐标：长度为正、角度在 [0,2π)。先画图，再查符号。 提醒周三中午 12 点截止；Quiz 计分，hand-in 用于反馈，不计总评；可以提交不完整尝试。准时下课。

quick.action: 09:47 无条件收尾。先独立写 30–45 秒，再请一人解释；核对后提醒 9 月 30 日中午截止，09:50 下课。

check.en: The length is 2 and the angle is three pi over two. Why does pi over two point the wrong way? If polar coordinates were not covered today, give only the endpoint, sketch and length.
check.cn: λ=2，θ=3π/2；π/2 指向上方而不是下方。若本节没讲极坐标，只检查终点、图和长度，不临时增加新知识。

title: 临场应对：太快、太慢、已经见过答案
subtitle: 参考 · 不计入主线

blocks.en: I have already seen the answer.
blocks.cn: 我已经看过答案了。

blocks.en: Then explain a check without looking at it. For example, choose a nonzero vector on a different axis and ask your partner for a polar representation in the same interval.
blocks.cn: 那请不看答案，解释一个检查办法。例如另选一个轴上的非零向量，让同伴在同样区间里写极形式。

blocks.text: 30 秒迁移题可用 (−2,0)：λ=2、θ=π。要求解释为什么不是 θ=0，不只报数。此题是自编检查，不冒充原题。

blocks.en: I don't know where to start.
blocks.cn: 我不知道从哪开始。

blocks.en: Let us choose just one step. Can you mark the two components on a sketch, or simplify the first bracket? Tell me what each symbol means before we calculate.
blocks.cn: 先只选一步：能在图上标两个分量，或先化第一个括号吗？计算前先说符号意思。

blocks.en: Can you show the whole homework solution?
blocks.cn: 能把作业完整答案讲一下吗？

blocks.en: I can help you identify a starting point and discuss what is unclear. I won't go through the full hand-in solution now; the argument should be your own.
blocks.cn: 可以帮你找入手点并解释不清楚的地方，但现在不逐步展示 hand-in 完整答案，论证应由你自己完成。

blocks.en: We have time for one more check, not a whole new topic. Let us make sure this idea is clear, then finish on time.
blocks.cn: 时间只够再检查一点，不够开新主题。先把这个概念弄清，再准时结束。

blocks.text: 学得很快时可改用正式 Q1.13（完整资料 B13），替换重复计算而非延长下课时间。先确认已学过三角不等式的证明；不要把 Q1.13 与待交 Q1.1 混淆。

blocks.en: If these calculations are familiar, look at Question 1.13 on the problem sheet. Which dot-product properties justify the first expansion? Why does Cauchy–Schwarz give an upper bound even when the dot product is negative? Why may we take square roots at the end?
blocks.cn: 如果这些计算已熟悉，看正式 Q1.13：开头展开用了哪些点积性质？点积为负时，柯西–施瓦茨为何仍给出上界？最后为何可以开平方？

blocks.text: 教师核对：展开用分配律（双线性）和对称性；v·w ≤ |v·w| ≤ ‖v‖‖w‖；最后两边非负，平方根在非负数上保序。让学生说出理由，不只念公式。

say.en: If you have seen the answer, explain why it works or try a small variation. If you are stuck, choose one first step and tell me what the symbols mean. We can slow down without trying to cover every optional activity.
say.cn: 见过答案就解释理由或做小变式；卡住就选一步，说符号含义。允许放慢，不必覆盖可选题。

quick.action: 参考页，出现对应情况才读。不要假设所有学生基础一样。

check.en: For the vector minus two, zero, what positive length and allowed angle would you use?
check.cn: 长度 2、角 π；位于负横轴而不是正横轴。

title: 英文读音与紧急主线
subtitle: 参考 · 抬头说，不连续读完

blocks.en: component; magnitude; modulus; conjugate; scalar; dot product; clockwise; anticlockwise.
blocks.cn: 分量；大小/长度；模；共轭；标量；点积；顺时针；逆时针。

blocks.en: pi over four; three pi over two; five over the square root of two; one plus i; a plus b i.
The interval from zero inclusive to two pi exclusive.
blocks.cn: 区间包含 0，不包含 2π；别只说“between”而忽略端点。

blocks.text: 紧急主线：概念 + 2−i 的图 → A2 只听一组完整解释 → A3/A4 各核对一个表示 → A5 共轭与乘回 → 09:47 收尾。先取消 A6，不取消学生动笔与理解检查。

blocks.en: What does the picture tell us? Which component changes? Does your answer satisfy the original equation? Can you explain why that step is valid?
blocks.cn: 图告诉我们什么？哪个分量改变？答案满足原方程吗？能解释这一步为什么成立吗？

say.en: What does the picture tell us? Which component changes? Does the answer satisfy the original equation? Can you explain why that step is valid? These short questions are enough to turn a calculation into a discussion.
say.cn: 用“图告诉什么、哪个分量、代回成立吗、这步为什么”四类短问题带讨论。

quick.action: 课前练术语；上课只查需要的一句，不把参考页当额外教学环节。

check.en: What does inclusive mean in the required angle interval?
check.cn: 左端点 0 允许；右端点 2π 不允许。
